mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of months where both series show positive growth.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past three months supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of months meeting the threshold conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches a peak, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 annual growth exceeding 2.5%, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
